gen-fs-expose-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara has round, open letterforms with tall bowls, almost like glass tubing bent into shape, under a tightly packed Expose heading. The strongest quality here is the tension between compressed and generous.
gen-fs-expose-gf-huninn: Modern and crisp, Huninn draws its letters like a drafting pen with one constant nib width, tall lowercase nearly touching cap height. Expose sits above in tight, striking lines, and the body gives that compression room to breathe.
gen-fs-expose-gf-inter-tight: Tight, striking, and rope-smooth. Expose packs its heading lines with barely a pause between lowercase and caps, while Inter Tight keeps its sans-serif text steady, with short ascenders and curves that hold back their tails.
gen-fs-expose-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, its capitals and lowercase nearly matching in height, with wide gaps between letters. And Expose, refined and compressed above it, gives that spaciousness a sharp, striking counterpoint.
gen-fs-expose-gf-karla: Compressed, striking lines define Expose, with barely any gap between lowercase and caps. Karla does the opposite job in the text, a stocky sans with a gaping c opening that settles the eye after the heading's rush.
gen-fs-expose-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and unfussy, its tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly and curves that keep their mouths open. And Expose rides above it, compressed and striking, so the text comes across as the softer partner.
gen-fs-expose-gf-krub: Contemporary and tidy, Krub brings a pronounced x-height beneath the heading. What stands out most is how Expose's tight, striking compression gives the text's unfinished, pen-lifted curves a lot of room to stretch.
gen-fs-expose-gf-kufam: Contemporary in feel, Kufam draws one single track width like a neon sign tube, with generously open curves in e under Expose's striking, compressed heading. The strongest quality is the contrast in density.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend: Compact, striking Expose on top, then Lexend with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, gentle and monotone in its line. Text in this sans-serif would feel easy and unhurried.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-deca: Tight, refined lines from Expose lead, while Lexend Deca follows with an unshaded stroke and big lowercase beside small-looking capitals. They work as a pair because the heading hurries and the sans slows down.
